pinRationale: The matrix's only positive NDK case. Every other repo in the corpus builds no native code at all, so without this one the NDK/CMake path is only ever asserted as absent and a regression that silently stopped emitting them would go unnoticed. Extraction runs at the repository root (not at an individual sample), so the 44-project tree is resolved in one pass. Both versions come from build-logic convention plugins rather than module build files — exactly the case build-file text parsing would miss (see #38).
groundTruthMethod: gradleVersion/androidSdkVersion/moduleCount/androidNdkVersion/androidCmakeVersion were read from the build files at the pinned commit: gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties, settings.gradle, and build-logic/src/main/java/com/android/ndk/samples/buildlogic/Versions.kt. jdkVersion and androidBuildToolsVersion are resolved values rather than literal build-file entries. All of it was then confirmed against a live `gradlezilla generate --dry-run --format json` run on this exact pinned checkout, which also matches the maintainer's independent verification recorded in #38.

jdkVersion.source: PROVISIONAL — this is the one field here that is not project-derived ground truth. It tracks the JDK that launched extraction: 21 on a JDK-21 daemon (jdkVersionSource="bytecodeTarget"), but 17 on a JDK-17 daemon (jdkVersionSource="agpMinimum"). Cause: the root project leaves Kotlin's jvmTarget unset, and extractor.gradle reads kotlinExt.compilerOptions.jvmTarget, whose convention resolves from the daemon JVM — the same host-JVM leak the file already refuses for JavaPluginExtension. Tracked in issue #40. 21 is what the matrix runner (JDK 21, set by actions/setup-java) produces, and matches the maintainer verification recorded in #38, so it is asserted here to keep the corpus honest about current behaviour rather than silently skipped. When #40 lands, re-derive this from the project and add ndk-samples to e2e/determinism.sh, whose cross-launcher-JDK check would fail on this today. Nothing in the project declares 21: the convention plugins set compileOptions to Versions.JAVA = VERSION_1_8, and AGP 8.13.0 (gradle/libs.versions.toml agp = "8.13.0") has a JDK-17 minimum

androidSdkVersion.source: build-logic/src/main/java/com/android/ndk/samples/buildlogic/Versions.kt: COMPILE_SDK = 35, applied to every module by AndroidApplicationConventionPlugin/AndroidLibraryConventionPlugin

androidBuildToolsVersion.source: verified run: not set anywhere in the build files; this is AGP 8.13.0's own default build-tools version

moduleCount.source: settings.gradle has 26 explicit include(...) statements; 18 of them use multi-segment paths whose first segment has no include(...) line of its own (bitmap-plasma, camera, endless-tunnel, exceptions, gles3jni, hello-gl2, hello-jni, hello-jniCallback, hello-vulkan, native-activity, native-audio, native-codec, native-midi, orderfile, sanitizers, sensor-graph, teapots, unit-test), and Gradle creates each as an implicit parent project — 26 + 18 = 44. build-logic is a separate included build (pluginManagement.includeBuild) and is not counted. Confirmed by verified run

ndkPresent.source: externalNativeBuild is configured: every sample points externalNativeBuild.cmake.path at its own src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt, and AndroidApplicationConventionPlugin/AndroidLibraryConventionPlugin set android.ndkVersion and externalNativeBuild.cmake.version build-wide

androidNdkVersion.source: build-logic/.../Versions.kt: NDK = "29.0.14206865" (r29), assigned to android.ndkVersion by the convention plugins

androidCmakeVersion.source: build-logic/.../Versions.kt: CMAKE = "4.1.0", assigned to android.externalNativeBuild.cmake.version by the convention plugins — an explicitly pinned version, so AGP's CMakeVersion.DEFAULT fallback (3.22.1) is not used here
